'''E5-D5''' was the designation of a [[Cleaning droid/Legends|utility droid]] of the [[Balmorran resistance]] working on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Galactic War]]. It was a sole survivor of a disaster mission and was begging [[Sheed]] to mount an effort to recover the supplies that were lost to enemy during the ambush.<ref name="CTR" />
